item.tib: yab sras thugs bsgrubs rgyud las mkha' 'gro 'od 'bar bsnyan rgyud spyi bskangs bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun rin chen gter tshom 'bar ba
item.coloph: ces par me rta zla tshes mkha' 'gro 'od ldan 'bar ma'i (mas) kho bo g.yung drung bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal la snyan du brgyud cing ma d+hAl ri khrod du gtan la phab pa'o
